description: This file defines a Grain class PromiseForwardGrain with methods to access and manipulate a simple grain's state, and includes a serializable state class SimpleGrainState. It appears to be part of an Orleans project implementing grain logic and state management.

classes.name: SimpleGrainState
classes.description: Serializable class representing the state of a grain, holding properties A and EventDelay.

classes.name: PromiseForwardGrain
classes.description: A grain class that provides methods to set, get, and perform calculations with its associated SimpleGrain, identified as an Orleans grain with storage provider attachment.
